meta.name: adaptyv
meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization. Also trigger when code imports `adaptyv`, `adaptyv_sdk`, or `FoundryClient`, or references `foundry-api-public.adaptyvbio.com`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交蛋白序列开展结合与稳定性实验,取回测定结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常做蛋白工程实验,想要一套清晰的送检与结果获取指南。
copy.tagline_en: Submit protein sequences for binding and stability assays, then retrieve results.

howto.what: Claude 会用 Adaptyv Foundry API 与 Python SDK 帮你操作蛋白实验：查靶点、估算费用、创建并提交实验，之后拉取结果。
howto.when: 当你提到 Adaptyv、Foundry API、蛋白结合实验等关键词，或代码导入 adaptyv、FoundryClient 时触发，用于提交蛋白序列做实验表征。

say.text: 帮我用 Adaptyv 查一下 EGFR 这个靶点，看哪些可以自助下单
say.note: 搜索靶点并筛选可自助下单的

say.text: 给这几条序列做一次 BLI 结合筛选实验，先估算费用再提交
say.note: 先估算费用，再创建并提交实验

say.text: 查一下我上一个实验的结果，用 get_results 拉回来

howto.what_en: Claude uses the Adaptyv Foundry API and Python SDK to work with protein experiments: list targets, estimate cost, create and submit assays (binding, thermostability, expression, fluorescence), and fetch results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention Adaptyv, Foundry API, or protein binding assays, when code imports adaptyv or FoundryClient, or when you submit protein sequences for characterization.

say_en.text: Find the EGFR target on Adaptyv and show self-service options
say_en.note: Runs targets.list with the search and selfservice filter

say_en.text: Run a BLI screening assay on these sequences, estimating cost first
say_en.note: Calls cost_estimate, then create and submit

say_en.text: Pull the results for my last experiment
say_en.note: Calls get_results for that experiment id
